chapter: Bix, Trumbauer and the Goldkette sidemen
title: When Morehouse joined: 1926 and the band's makeup
summary: Virginia and Kline settle that he joined in 1926, with Wilcox, Rank, Ryker and Jimmy Dorsey still in the band under Russ Morgan.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Were you drinking that much then?
You didn't do that. You looked around at all these guys that were all drunk.
Chauncey came a little later. Chauncey came about, it was '26 or '27.
Well he was recording with them in '24.
Well let me see. Your brother was '24. '26, '26.
All right, in '26 you still had Spiegel, Wilcox, Bill Rank, Doc Ryker, Jimmy Dorsey.
And they had something concrete too.
I see. Russ Morgan was still leading the group though.
